assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: All submitted spatial geometry is clipped to the repository provisional boundary; official polygons are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Every area, ratio, corridor and key-area relationship must be recalculated after official polygons arrive.

assumptions.statement: Events, testbeds and operating bodies are reference mechanisms, not confirmed government commitments.
assumptions.impact: Governance, procurement, safety, privacy and funding require owner confirmation.

assumptions.statement: No parcel ownership, building survey or approved height/FAR controls are available.
assumptions.impact: Building and renewal moves remain method statements rather than parcel-level decisions.

assumptions.statement: The Unscanned Line and AI Pause Station are public-space design principles, not a claim that legally required public-safety systems can be removed.
assumptions.impact: Detailed design must separate statutory public-safety duties from commercial sensing, identity recognition, behavioural scoring and optional experience systems.

assumptions.statement: No measured electricity, water, carbon, network-resilience or non-AI usage baseline is available for the proposed AI service nodes.
assumptions.impact: Resource and continuity thresholds must be set after metering and service observation; Beijing data-centre PUE policy cannot be directly applied to small edge devices.
